description: The Danish residential prosumer research team publishes 600,000 synthetic days of electricity imported from and exported to the grid. The collection labels user types, day types and temperature information to support residential demand and generation studies. One Figshare archive contains the dataset in Python pickle and XLSX formats, a README, and code for visualisation and scenario studies. Access is free under CC0. Geographic coverage is Denmark, while the synthetic days should not be interpreted as a continuous observed household history. The profiles can support distributed-resource scenarios and network studies with model-pypsa or platform-opendss after mapping each profile to suitable connections and equipment. A caveat is that synthetic data preserve selected relationships from their generation process and may not reproduce rare behaviour or every household class. The archive was not downloaded, so numerical distributions and the packaged README were not independently checked.
